Flow.description: Update Message: v1, initial version (POC-Antioch Phase 2). The one transaction the POC Case Creation Agent calls. Mode CREATE validates the inputs, checks the POC_Create_Case_Allowed custom permission, reserves a POC_Submission_Log__c row keyed on SubmissionId, creates the Case and marks the log Created. Mode CHECK only reads the running user's log. The Flow, not the agent, sets Requester (running user), Channel (Agent Assisted), Origin (Agent), Type (from Category) and Priority (Medium). Runs in system context without sharing because the log is Private; the Flow enforces the custom permission itself and never returns another user's case.

formulas.name: forB_Allowed
formulas.description: True when the running user holds the POC_Create_Case_Allowed custom permission.

formulas.name: forT_Mode
formulas.description: Mode in upper case without spaces.

formulas.name: forT_SubjectTrim
formulas.description: Subject without leading or trailing spaces.

formulas.name: forT_DescriptionTrim
formulas.description: Description without leading or trailing spaces.

formulas.name: forT_CaseType
formulas.description: Case Type for the Category; blank when the Category is not in the map.
formulas.expression: CASE(TRIM({!Category}), "General Inquiry", "General Inquiry", "Access Request", "Access Request", "Technical Issue", "Technical Issue", "")

formulas.name: forT_CreateValidationMessage
formulas.description: Names the first invalid Create input; blank when all are valid.
formulas.expression: IF(ISBLANK(TRIM({!SubmissionId})), "SubmissionId is required.", IF(LEN({!SubmissionId}) > 80, "SubmissionId must be 80 characters or fewer.", IF(ISBLANK(TRIM({!Subject})), "Subject is required.", IF(LEN(TRIM({!Subject})) > 255, "Subject must be 255 characters or fewer.", IF(ISBLANK(TRIM({!Description})), "Description is required.", IF(ISBLANK(TRIM({!Category})), "Category is required.", IF(ISBLANK({!forT_CaseType}), "Category must be General Inquiry, Access Request or Technical Issue.", IF(LEN(TRIM({!Description})) + LEN({!forT_NotesText}) + LEN({!forT_RefsText}) + 80 > 32000, "Description, troubleshooting notes and knowledge references together are too long.", ""))))))))

formulas.name: forB_CreateInvalid
formulas.description: True when a Create input is invalid.

formulas.name: forT_CheckValidationMessage
formulas.description: Names the invalid Check input; blank when valid.
formulas.expression: IF(ISBLANK(TRIM({!SubmissionId})), "SubmissionId is required.", IF(LEN({!SubmissionId}) > 80, "SubmissionId must be 80 characters or fewer.", ""))

formulas.name: forB_CheckInvalid
formulas.description: True when a Check input is invalid.

formulas.name: forB_ExactMatch
formulas.description: True when the found log has exactly the same submission ID, including letter case (the lookup itself ignores case).

formulas.name: forB_SameRequester
formulas.description: True when the found log belongs to the running user.

formulas.name: forT_DuplicateMessage
formulas.expression: "This submission already created case " & {!varR_ExistingCase.CaseNumber} & ". No new case was created."
